question: Complete the FY2025 sponsor league table when the remaining TY2025 returns are indexed: 26 of the FY2024 top 50 (GS DAPF, SVCF, MS GIFT, AEF, RCF, NCF, BofA CGF, ImpactAssets, FFTC, GKCCF and others; 29.4% of FY2024 top-50 corrected assets) have no parsed FY2025 return in index_2026 (Last-Modified 2026-10-21). Re-run scripts/mission_league_table.py after an FY2025 R1-R4 correction pass, including the Ayco/GS DAPF double-count check, and only then report FY2025 ranks, market shares, CR/HHI and top-50 churn
conclusion_affected: FY2025 market size, concentration (CR5 56.9% assets FY2024) and the ranking of GS DAPF after absorbing Ayco
rationale: FY2025 coverage is 899 sponsors holding 67.6% of FY2024 corrected assets and 62.4% of grants; FY2025 ranks and CRs computed on covered filers alone are not market figures. The 24 covered FY2024 top-50 sponsors grew assets +23.2% (FY2025 filed vs FY2024 corrected), so the FY2025 cut-off will move; six non-top-50 filers already exceed the FY2024 rank-50 value ($0.581bn)

question: Build a parent-group league table and concentration series FY2021-2025 that consolidates affiliated sponsor EINs (GS DAPF + Ayco + Goldman Sachs Charitable Gift Fund; Dechomai Asset Trust + Dechomai Foundation; Donors Trust + Donors Capital Fund; NPT + NPT Charitable Asset Trust; Impact Investing Charitable Foundation + Trust; same-name CF pairs) from the W5 affiliate list and Schedule R related-organisation tables, netting intra-group transfers, and add a sensitivity row with SDG Impact Fund (non-DAFRC, $10.10bn FY2021-22)
conclusion_affected: Whether the EIN-level CR3/CR5 and HHI understate concentration by commercial sponsor family; who is #5 in FY2021-22
rationale: The EIN-level table treats GS DAPF (rank 5, $12.64bn FY2024), Ayco (rank 25, $1.16bn corrected) and the Goldman Sachs Charitable Gift Fund (rank 57, $0.52bn) as three competitors although they share a parent and merged in 2025. SDG Impact Fund's filed $10.10bn would rank 6th in FY2021 and 5th in FY2022 if DAFRC included it. Schedule R and the batch-34 W5 list already identify most pairs, so effort is low
